title: Country Inn Steeped in History/Hachland-Poplar #1
description:
Hachland Hill's Main Inn is a cabin/lodge with logs over 200 years old. Situated on 90 acres of stunning, natural beauty (flowers, shrubs, spring fed creek, abundant wildlife) + hiking trails for your enjoyment. The Main Inn is perfect for solo-travelers, couples looking for a serene escape or a family getaway. You'll be at home in the country, but just a short drive from downtown Nashville and the airport.

The space
Poplar #1 bedroom has two double/full beds. This bedroom has a private bathroom. The common areas of the Main Inn include a living room with television and a dining room with a beautiful view. There is a large Rec room with pool/ping pong, and a large
terrace with plenty of seating and a fire pit, The inn is appointed with primitive antiques and handmade quilts, yet offers modern comforts and conveniences in the bedrooms and common areas.

Guest access
The main inn offers 10,000 square feet of space.  Make yourselves at home indoors and out on the beautiful terrace overlooking the woods, and the comfortable porches.  Hike and explore the wooded hills and open meadows. Enjoy outdoor relaxation on the main inn terrace and in in the rec room with pool/ping pong.

Other things to note
Designed and appointed with love by Tennessee Treasure, Phila Hach (chef, author, TV personality). Pictures just don't do the setting justice. Eight other private rooms are available as well as our smaller inn, Spring Creek (5BR/5BA) in its entirety for groups up to 16.

host_details:
My family and I operate a dining inn/retreat/event venue called Hachland Hill.  We offer an authentic Nashville experience. We love nature, good music, good friends, and good food. We offer up to 15 sleeping rooms in two separate inns. On 80 acres, our guests enjoy the best of nature and privacy. Plenty of hiking, outdoor seating and entertainment, like fire pits, corn hole, etc..  We're known for elevated Southern cuisine.  Plan your group or private dining experience with us! Only 25 minutes from the excitement of downtown and from the  airport, you'll find the best of worlds at Hachland Hill.
